data.name: Whales and You
data.headline: 30% Off! with Code EB30 – Only in Winter! Witness the Whale Migration from Alaska
data.description:
Join us on a whale-watching adventure along Oahu's stunning Gold Coast, where you can witness humpback whales and other marine life in their natural habitat. The experience includes a Hawaiian cultural ceremony, live commentary from a naturalist, and the opportunity to hear whale songs with a hydrophone. Relax on our double-decker boat and enjoy the scenic ocean views.

[Disclaimer]
We warmly welcome infants (0–2 years) on our tours! For their safety, strollers and wheelchairs are not permitted on our trolleys and boats, and infants cannot occupy seats, they should be held by a caregiver throughout the tour.

Depending on weather and ocean conditions, boats may experience waves and rocking. Please note that there are no facilities for infants on board, and the crew and captain are not responsible for childcare.

data.cancellation_summary: Cancellations or changes must be made at least 48 hours before the departure time for a full refund
data.cancellation_notes:
**Cancellation Policy**
Any cancellations or amendments (tour date, time, etc.) must be made at least 48 hours prior to the departure time on the reservation date to receive a full refund of the tour fees.

Reservations made within 48 hours of departure are considered FINAL SALE. Please be aware that we do not provide refunds for no-shows or late arrivals.

**Combo/Upsell Packages**
Combo or upsell bookings cannot be partially canceled. Cancellations must be made for all tours within the package. 

If one tour has already been used and you wish to cancel the remaining tour, no refund will be issued.

**Doctor's Note Exception**
With a valid doctor's note, a full refund may be issued after the designated cancellation period.
- The doctor's note applies only to the person named on the note
- If the person holding the note is a minor (under 12 years old), we will also honor one adult guardian for a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
#ALOHA,
Thank you for booking your **Whales and You** tour with [And You Creations](https://andyoucreations.com/).

Please read through this entire email for important general information regarding your tour. Don't hesitate to contact us if you have any questions or special requests.

Mahalo!
_________________________
#MEETING LOCATION

Trolley transportation is available from three locations in Waikiki.

For guests who prefer to meet directly, please meet us at **Kewalo Basin Boat Harbor Pier D, Gate 111 ** [1125 Ala Moana Blvd D111, Honolulu, HI 96814](https://goo.gl/maps/gcpaNbTnFbA19to3A) (click on address for Google Map) no later than 6:45AM. Kewalo Basin Boat Harbor is 10-15 minutes from Waikiki.

Public parking is available but limited, and fees apply. If you plan to come by rental car, please arrive well ahead of your tour time to secure a spot. Uber, Lyft, and taxis are also available.

**Please call 808-696-4414 for questions or assistance.**
_________________________

#WHAT TO BRING:
• Sunscreen, Sunglasses, Hat
• A light jacket for a cool ocean breeze
• Camera / smartphone
• Guests are encouraged to come in easily removable shoes or sandals.
• Motion Sickness Medicine (For those who are prone to getting seasick, we recommend taking medication an hour before the tour start time)
• Adult beverages will be available for purchase on the boat. Hard liquor goes from $6 to $12. Beer and Seltzers are $6.
• Our meals do not accommodate allergies, We do not prepare the meals so we cannot guarantee anything regarding allergies. For your safety, please prepare your own.

You will be asked to remove your shoes before boarding the boat. This is for your safety. We will have storage for you to place them in during your time onboard. Clean reef shoes and grip socks are permitted.

Please limit your belongings to one bag per group due to limited space on the boat.

If you have a US number that we can reach out to, please contact us. 

Smoking, vaping, alcohol consumption, and the use or possession of illegal drugs are not permitted on our premises, including our buses and boats. Guests who do not comply with this policy may be denied service or removed from the premises at our discretion, without refund.

data.extras:
**Whale-Sighting Guarantee Policy**
- The Whale Guarantee allows free rebooking only; no refunds are given if no whales are sighted.
- The captain will only designate a tour as a "no-whale-sighting tour" if no guests on the tour spot a whale. If even one guest sees a whale, the tour will not qualify as a "no-whale-sighting tour."
- If the captain determines that no whale was sighted, you may rebook the “Whales and You” tour for free until a whale is seen.
- Free rebooking is only valid for tours with open seats, and specific dates or times cannot be guaranteed.
- Guests who cannot join another tour during their stay may redeem the Whale Guarantee at any time within three years of the original tour date.
- Free rebooking applies only to the original guest(s) and cannot be transferred.
data.faqs:
- **What should I bring?** Sunscreen, sunglasses, hat, a light jacket, and your camera are recommended. If you are prone to seasickness, take motion sickness medicine before the tour.

- **Are whale sightings guaranteed?** While whale sightings are not guaranteed, this tour offers a high chance of seeing whales during their migration season.

- **Can I bring a stroller or wheelchair on the trolley or boat?**
For safety reasons, strollers and wheelchairs are not allowed on our trolleys and boats.

- **Can infants (0–2 years) occupy a seat?**
Infants cannot occupy seats and must be held by a caregiver throughout the tour.

- **Are there facilities for infants on the boat?**
No, there are no facilities for infants on board.
